messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — enterprise POC with VoltSystems needs our approval turnaround guaranteed within 48h for discounts/terms. They asked if approvals can be auto-routed based on CPQ fields.
Jon (Deal Desk): Can you share the commit/discount thresholds they're asking for? Also any special T&C?
Maya (AE): They're asking for 30% off on Dedicated for a 12mo commit, and a custom data-residency clause. Wants legal + deal desk in parallel if possible.
Priya (CPQ): We can set automated routing in SF CPQ. Proposal: discounts <=15% auto-approve, 15-25% route to Deal Desk (Jon), >25% route to VP Sales + Legal. For custom clauses route to Legal and Escalations queue. Example rule snippet: ```
// CPQ approval rule pseudo
IF DiscountPercent > 25 THEN Approver = VP_SALES; AddFlag("legal_review")
ELSE IF DiscountPercent > 15 THEN Approver = DEAL_DESK
ELSE Approver = AUTO_APPROVE
```
Lee (Presales): For POC-specific SLAs we try to fast-path approvals. If we tag Opportunity.Type == "POC" and Opportunity.POC_Tier == "enterprise" then route to Deal Desk with high priority SLA (48h).
dealdeck-bot: Created ticket DD-4921 for VoltSystems, assigned to Jon. SLA: 48 hours business time. ETA auto-set.
Jon (Deal Desk): OK I'll own DD-4921. Two asks: 1) add a CPQ checkbox "expedite_48h" set by AE when customer requests fast approval; 2) ensure CPQ triggers a parallel workflow to Legal for data-residency clauses. That reduces serial blocking.
Priya (CPQ): I can add the expedite_48h boolean and the parallel workflow. Need exact field names for Salesforce mapping. Proposed mapping: ["Opportunity.Type","Opportunity.POC_Tier","Opportunity.DiscountPercent","Opportunity.Expedite_48h","Opportunity.DataResidencyFlag"]
Sam (Security): Data-residency clause will require Security questionnaire and KMS details. We need a Security intake linked to the deal (add link in CPQ to the questionnaire doc). Can we require questionnaire complete before Legal sign-off?
Maya (AE): Yes, VoltSystems already sent an initial Sec questionnaire. I uploaded it to the deal record (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/POC-volt-qs).
Jon (Deal Desk): Workflow summary I need implemented: 1) AE ticks expedite_48h for POC enterprise deals, 2) CPQ routes to Deal Desk and Legal in parallel, 3) If DataResidencyFlag==true then attach Security checklist and block final approval until checklist status==complete, 4) Discounts >25% escalate to VP Sales as well.
Priya (CPQ): I'll open a CPQ config PR and a SF field deploy. ETA for deploy to sandbox: 2 days. ETA for prod change (after signoff): 5 business days.
Lee (Presales): Can we also add a notification to the AE Slack channel when route happens? Small webhook to #sales-alerts would be enough.
Jon (Deal Desk): Good idea — include deal link + SLA countdown. That helps triage.
Sam (Security): I'll review the questionnaire now. If anything blocks, I'll post within 24h.
Maya (AE): Amazing — thanks team. Please ping me in-thread once CPQ sandbox change is up so I can exercise with Volt. :thumbsup:
Jon (Deal Desk): Closing action items: Priya to PR CPQ rules, Sam to validate security checklist, Jon to monitor DD-4921 SLA.
Maya (AE): Ack.
Priya (CPQ): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/cpq-config/pull/213 (sandbox rules).
Jon (Deal Desk): I'll mark DD-4921 status: In progress.
dealdesk-bot: DD-4921 status updated -> In progress (owner: Jon). SLA countdown: 47h 59m.
